object-1l.alt: ANDOR OSP presented as an object, standing at an angle: one recording loaded, a chord held.
object-1l.treatment: Studio render (tools/render-object.py --view stand): the genuine capture is the face (emission, exact colours); the slab sides are textured from the capture's own teak cheek. No controls or hardware added.

object-3l.alt: ANDOR OSP presented as an object with three layers loaded.
object-3l.treatment: Studio render (tools/render-object.py --view stand): the genuine capture is the face (emission, exact colours); the slab sides are textured from the capture's own teak cheek. No controls or hardware added.

object-imprint.alt: ANDOR OSP presented as an object with the SYNTH page open in IMPRINT mode.
object-imprint.treatment: Studio render (tools/render-object.py --view stand): the genuine capture is the face (emission, exact colours); the slab sides are textured from the capture's own teak cheek. No controls or hardware added.

osp-hero-1l.alt: ANDOR OSP with one recording loaded: a large waveform display, five source knobs, six macro knobs and a keyboard with a chord held.

osp-hero-3l.alt: ANDOR OSP with three layers: a sung vowel, a granular pluck and a low vowel with IMPRINT synthesis.

osp-hero-2l.alt: ANDOR OSP with two layers loaded side by side.

osp-empty.alt: ANDOR OSP before a sound is loaded, inviting you to drop a sound.

osp-imprint.alt: The SYNTH page in IMPRINT mode, showing the oscillator cycle shaped by the recording's spectral body.

osp-analog.alt: The SYNTH page in ANALOG mode with a sawtooth cycle.

osp-reimagined-mosaic.alt: The REIMAGINED popover in MOSAIC mode over the waveform.

crop-display.alt: The dark waveform display of ANDOR OSP with a recording and five playheads.
crop-display.use: H2 opening frame (matched cut into osp-hero-1l)

crop-macros.alt: The six ceramic macro knobs: LIFE, DRIVE, CHARACTER, MOVEMENT, ECHO and SPACE.

crop-knob-life.alt: The LIFE macro knob, a ceramic dial with a terracotta arc.

crop-keybed.alt: The keyboard with an open C major seventh chord held.

crop-teak.alt: The ANDOR/OSP logotype beside the teak side panel.
crop-teak.use: Detail gallery: timber frame and logotype

crop-imprint-display.alt: The IMPRINT oscillator cycle on the dark display.

crop-mosaic-popover.alt: The MOSAIC popover: its harmonic fingerprint, DETAIL and MOTION knobs, and model.

dd-recording-empty.alt: ANDOR OSP before a sound is loaded: a large drop area that says Drop a sound.

dd-recording-loaded.alt: Three loaded layers, each with its own waveform display and controls.

dd-life.alt: The LIFE popover: mode Natural, a performance curve, CHARACTER, TAKES, ORDER, PITCH, TONE and ATTACK.

dd-space.alt: The SPACE popover: Room, Hall, Plate and Spring, a decay picture with low and high cut, and its controls.

dd-synth-analog.alt: The SYNTH page in Analog mode: a saw cycle, with wave, octave, detune, tone, shape and pitch controls.

dd-synth-imprint.alt: The SYNTH page in Imprint mode: the oscillator cycle shaped by the recording, IMPRINT at 85 %.

dd-synth-motion.alt: The SYNTH page in Imprint mode with MOTION at 60 %.

dd-arp.alt: The arpeggiator panel above the keyboard: which layers it plays, sixteen steps, the pattern, rate, octaves, gate, swing and velocity.

dd-reimagined-kaleidoscope.alt: The REIMAGINED popover in KALEIDOSCOPE mode, with its picture and its two controls.

dd-reimagined-tape-frame.alt: The REIMAGINED popover in TAPE FRAME mode, with its picture and its two controls.

dd-reimagined-toybox.alt: The REIMAGINED popover in TOYBOX mode, with its picture and its two controls.

dd-reimagined-mosaic.alt: The REIMAGINED popover in MOSAIC mode, with its picture and its two controls.

dd-reimagined-mirage.alt: The REIMAGINED popover in MIRAGE mode, with its picture and its two controls.

bub-recording.alt: The drop area of ANDOR OSP: Drop a sound, one tonal recording is enough, with Browse, Load example and Record buttons.

bub-synth.alt: The SYNTH page in Imprint mode: the oscillator cycle shaped by the recording, with wave, octave, detune and tone controls.

syn-sample.alt: The waveform display of layer A with the SYNTH chip at 0 %: the recording on its own.

gran-card.alt: Layer A in Granular mode: the recording as a cloud of grains, with POS, SIZE, DENS, TUNE and SPREAD over the display and the KEY DNA key.

feat-notemap.alt: The NOTE MAP: a recorded phrase split into six notes, F5 selected, with pitch, fine tune and key controls.

feat-capture.alt: The CAPTURE page recording a phrase from the input, with GRAB LAST 10, 20, 30 and 60 seconds.

feat-keydna.alt: The KEY DNA window: grain SIZE drawn across the keyboard as a falling curve with per-key variation.

det-mod.alt: The modulation panel showing LFO 1 with its rate and shape controls.

syn-card-sample.alt: Layer A with SYNTH at 0 %: the recording on its own.

syn-card-analog.alt: Layer A with its SYNTH page open in Analog mode: a saw cycle and its controls.

syn-card-imprint.alt: Layer A with its SYNTH page in Imprint mode: the oscillator cycle shaped by the recording.

syn-card-motion.alt: Layer A with its SYNTH page in Imprint mode and MOTION at 60 %.
